==Developer Wiki===

This wiki contains information for UNICASE developers. There are are two ways of exploring this information, step-by-step-paths and following the hierarchical structure.

===Step-by-step paths===
Step-by-step paths guide you through the wiki following a predefined path step by step. They are a good way to discover all important information in a given scenario.
Currently the following paths are available:

 * [Getting_started_as_developer Getting started as Developer]

=== Hierarchical Structure ===

You can also access the contents by the hierarchical structure also reflected in the navigation bar on the right:

 * [Coding Coding - Information about coding with the UNICASE framework]
 * [Modeling Modeling - Information about modeling in UNICASE]
 * [Setup Set-up and Configuration - Guidelines for the set-up of your development environment and the configuration of plugins]
 * [Process Process - The development process of the UNICASE project]
 * [Video_Tutorials Video Tutorials]
 * [Links_and_References Links and References]
 * [FAQ FAQ]
